name: cruise
description: Enterprise cruise fleet operations platform for voyage administration, turnaround coordination, passenger services, and operational assurance
author: Jay Gallagher

scripts.start:prod: npm run db:bootstrap:render-demo && CRUISE_PUBLIC_DEMO_READ_MODE=enabled node index.js
scripts.start: npm run react:build && docker compose up -d && SUPPRESS_DB_LOGS=true DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:password@127.0.0.1:5433/cruise node index.js
scripts.integrationTests: npm run db:test:ready && NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 jest --config jest.integration.config.js --runInBand --detectOpenHandles
scripts.test: npm run jest:coverage:all && npm run uiTests:react
scripts.test:all: npm run repo:repair && npm run test:inventory:audit && npm run release:source:audit && npm run production:deployment:audit && npm run production:dependencies:audit && node scripts/verify-security-closeout.js && node scripts/verify-security-release-matrix.js && npm run react:production:complete && npm run ai:foundation:audit && npm run ai:foundation:readiness && npm run ai:foundation:complete && npm run ai:phase2:audit && npm run ai:phase2:complete && npm run ai:phase3:audit && npm run ai:phase3:complete && npm run ai:phase4:complete && npm run ai:phase5:audit && npm run ai:phase5:complete && npm run ai:phase6:audit && npm run ai:phase6:complete && npm run jest:coverage:all && npm run browserTests:react && npm run perf:smoke:local && npm run lighthouse:ci:local
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.lighthouse:ci:local: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:8000/health lighthouse:ci
scripts.lighthouse:ci:ci: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start:ci http://localhost:8000/health lighthouse:ci
scripts.playwright:mobile:ci: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start:ci http://localhost:8000 "playwright test --config=playwright.mobile.config.js playwright/mobile/react-production-mobile.spec.js"
scripts.playwright:responsive:ci: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start:ci http://localhost:8000 "playwright test --config=playwright.responsive.config.js playwright/responsive/react-production-responsive.spec.js"
scripts.uiTests:react: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:8000 cypress:run:react
scripts.playwright:mobile:react: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:8000 "playwright test --config=playwright.mobile.config.js playwright/mobile/react-production-mobile.spec.js"
scripts.playwright:responsive:react: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:8000 "playwright test --config=playwright.responsive.config.js playwright/responsive/react-production-responsive.spec.js"
scripts.browserTests:react: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start:test http://localhost:8000/health browserTests:react:run
scripts.react:production:audit: npm run react:readiness:audit && npm run react:production:complete && npm run browserTests:react
scripts.uiTests:react:ci: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start:ci http://localhost:8000 cypress:run:react
scripts.start:watch: npm run react:build && docker compose up -d && SUPPRESS_DB_LOGS=true DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:password@127.0.0.1:5433/cruise node --watch index.js
scripts.release:preflight: npm run release:integrity && npm run quality:source && npm run release:source:audit && npm run production:deployment:audit && npm run production:dependencies:audit && npm run react:production:complete && npm run ai:foundation:audit && npm run ai:foundation:readiness && npm run ai:foundation:complete && npm run ai:phase2:audit && npm run ai:phase2:complete && npm run ai:phase3:audit && npm run ai:phase3:complete && npm run ai:phase4:complete && npm run ai:phase5:audit
scripts.ai:foundation:test: NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 jest tests/unit/aiProvider.service.test.js tests/unit/openAiResponsesProvider.service.test.js tests/unit/aiRuntimeConfig.service.test.js tests/unit/aiProviderExecution.service.test.js tests/unit/aiCostEstimation.service.test.js tests/unit/aiTelemetry.service.test.js tests/unit/aiFoundationReadiness.service.test.js tests/unit/aiFoundationCompletion.service.test.js tests/unit/aiTurnaroundBriefing.service.test.js tests/unit/aiTurnaroundEvidence.service.test.js tests/unit/aiOperationalTurnaroundBriefing.service.test.js tests/unit/aiProgramStatus.service.test.js tests/unit/ai.controller.test.js tests/unit/aiFoundation.static.test.js --runInBand
scripts.start:test: docker compose up -d && SUPPRESS_DB_LOGS=true DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:password@127.0.0.1:5433/cruise node index.js
scripts.browserTests:react:run: npm run cypress:run:react && npm run playwright:mobile:run && npm run playwright:responsive:run
scripts.maintenance:check: npm run repo:hygiene && npm run quality:source && npm run test:inventory:audit && npm run release:source:audit && npm run production:deployment:audit && npm run production:dependencies:audit && node scripts/verify-security-closeout.js && node scripts/verify-security-release-matrix.js && npm run react:production:complete && npm run ai:foundation:complete && npm run ai:phase2:complete && npm run ai:phase3:complete && npm run ai:phase4:complete && npm run ai:phase5:complete && npm run ai:phase6:complete
scripts.quality:static: npm run quality:source && npm run release:source:audit && npm run production:deployment:audit && npm run production:dependencies:audit && npm run react:production:complete
